purpose: Describe where the final-only LQCR ranking intervention changes strict-IoU recall.
replication_unit: three independently trained parent detectors, each paired with its frozen-parent LQCR child
inference_pairing: the same inference seed is used within each parent-child pair

overlap_strata.definition: maximum IoU of a ground-truth box with any other ground-truth box in the same image

allowed_claim: Post-hoc descriptive gains occur in selected lower-area quartiles and moderate/high neighboring-overlap strata at strict IoU thresholds.
forbidden_claims: stratum comparisons are prespecified confirmatory tests
the reported sample SD is a confidence interval
